result:
I felt an intoxicating peace as I gazed at the deep, dark blue of the ocean below me. The sun was starting to set, and the waves rushed against the shore, their golden glow casting a warm, inviting feeling in my heart. I took a deep breath, feeling the cool ocean mist on my skin, and swallowed a large gulp of salty sea air. The sound and sight of the surf made a certain calming rhythm which caused me to feel in sync with nature. It is extraordinarily powerful. This serenity is the most beautiful gift of the ocean, and I am humbled by its beauty.
